newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Aug domestic WPI down 0.7 pct yr/yr--BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan Aug domestic WPI down 0.7 pct yr/yr--BOJ.

text.p: Japan's domestic wholesale price index, a key component of overall WPI, was down 0.7 percent in August from a year earlier, but flat from a month earlier, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Monday.
The following is a detailed breakdown of the August WPI:
Overall WPI was up 0.5 percent in August from a year earlier but down 0.2 percent from a month earlier, the BOJ said.
The August export and import wholesale price indices -- the other components of the overall WPI -- were up 5.0 percent and 10.3 percent, respectively, from a year earlier.
Export prices in August were down 0.9 percent month-on-month and import prices were 0.6 percent lower.
